sobre.fotoAlt: Inara Kelly do Carmo smiling, wearing hoop earrings, in front of a brick wall
paragrafos: I'm Inara, from Salvador, Bahia, Brazil. My path started in audiovisual production and today it meets strategy. I like to investigate, observe people, understand cultural movements and connect different references to find new possibilities for brands and businesses.

contato.texto: Good ideas start with encounters, exchanges and curiosity.

paragrafos: More than a professional path, the following projects show how my way of thinking, leading and turning strategy into business results has evolved.

blocos.texto: Qualitative research, focus groups and investigation into the reality of women entrepreneurs.
Curation of news, trends and industry movements.
Research on men's habits, culture and behavior around bathing.
Curation of opinion leaders and references in agribusiness.
Mystery shopping and investigation of the shopping experience and store differentiators.

paragrafos: Before working in strategy, I built my career in audiovisual and event production. That's where I developed my eye for the big picture and the ability to connect people, organize processes and turn ideas into deliverables.

blocos.texto: Production leadership, team, communication and processes.
Field production, agility, attention to process and adaptability.
